description: This file defines a CheckList node for a rich text editor, including its HTML rendering, input rules, commands, and keyboard shortcuts, as part of the Notesnook project.

classes.name: CheckList
classes.description: A custom node representing a checklist in the editor, with options for item type and HTML attributes, supporting toggle, input rules, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the checklist node, including item type name and HTML attributes.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how to parse HTML elements into this checklist node, specifically 'ul.simple-checklist'.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Renders the checklist node as a 'ul' element with class 'simple-checklist' and merged attributes.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Adds a command 'toggleCheckList' to toggle the checklist state.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules to convert specific input patterns into checklist items, including handling for 'x' to mark checked items.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcut for toggling the checklist.
